searchText: The current PTC selection algorithm doesn't consider validator effective balance, so a validator with an effective balance of 2048 ETH has the same chance of being selected as PTC as a validator with 32 ETH. Intuitively, this seems off, but I don't see any real issue with it. In fact, it might be preferable since being PTC carries more risk—if the proposer fails to propose, there's a lost reward. Treating a 2048 ETH validator like a 32 ETH validator might inherently reduce that risk... PTC selection was chosen in the simplest possible way indeed incidentally, most of us will be traveling Friday so I didn't open an issue for the breakout call, if you guys feel like having it please do so, but I can't be there since my flight takes about two days to get to Bangkok I'll be leaving on Thursday to be there Saturday Oh yeah, I think we should skip this Friday. I don’t think most people will be able to make it. We can chat more about this in person next week when everyone’s present 🙂
